notes.title: Undefeated Bip! champion playing Bip! Demo against all comers
notes.content:
Gonna play the Bip! demo against all and sundry (even if it's just bots), for a few hours at least.  Come join me, or come watch!

I'll answer any questions too, and maybe do some dev if we hit annoying bugs.

notes.title: Bip! demo liveplay + Q&A
notes.content: I'll play the Bip! demo with anyone who cares to join me, answer any questions, and maybe stream some development of the full game.

notes.title: Developer livestreams
notes.content:
Over the next few weeks I'll be streaming the further development of Bip!, as I work toward a demo release in June.

You can watch here on Steam, or at twitch.tv/onelivesleft

notes.title: Biplanes! demo livestream
notes.content:
A livestream of the currently in-development couch multiplayer 2D dogfighter (but with added networking for when you and your friends can't gather around the same big screen).  Come and watch me take on anyone who wants to play the demo, or grab it and fly against me yourself (and/or everyone else). 

This will be a combined demo and Q/A: as we play I'll be happy to talk about anything development related (or otherwise).

Watch the untrained bots flailing at each other:
